plastic.summary: Check whether your local recycling service accepts this type of plastic.
steps: Follow local instructions for recycling or disposal.

paper.summary: Clean, dry paper is commonly recyclable.
steps: Keep paper dry and free of food residue.
Use the locally accepted paper recycling stream.

glass.summary: Glass acceptance depends on the local collection service.
steps: Check whether the item is accepted by your local service.
Keep broken glass safely contained and follow local disposal rules.

metal.summary: Many metal containers can be recycled where accepted.

organic.summary: Food and garden waste may be suitable for composting where facilities exist.
steps: Separate organic waste from non-compostable materials.
Check which materials your composting service accepts.
Use an approved composting or organic waste collection method.

e-waste.summary: Electronic waste may require specialist collection.
steps: Do not place electronics in ordinary recycling unless local rules allow it.
Use an authorized e-waste collection or take-back service.
Do not dismantle batteries or electronic components unnecessarily.
